r.t: The salmon sushi I received was spoiled. The colour was much darker than usual, and it had a strong unpleasant smell. What made it worse was that the spoiled pieces seemed to be placed at the bottom, as if to make it less noticeable.
Always a wonderful experience at Maki and Ramen. Always a favourite of me and my wife.
Fantastic service. Food amazing!
Cozy restaurant with an excellent service and super delicious food. Highly recommended.
Simply the best Ramen I have tried so far... The staff, the service and the vibe were amazing... Highly recommended

Good broth

In Edinburgh, everything usually closes early; the only things that stay open are restaurants, especially Asian ones. Maki & Ramen saved our lives one night. The food was very good, with great flavor, excellent service, and they serve very quickly. So if you're hungry, don't hesitate. Two bowls of ramen cost around...
Delicious food and incredibly friendly staff , absolutely nothing to complain about.
Beautiful establishment, great staff and amazing food!
Really good and fresh food

It's like being back in Japan! The food, the aromas, and the kindness of the real Japan. The food is excellent and authentic, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere is clean and beautiful.
If you want to try authentic Japanese cuisine, you absolutely must stop here.
Congratulations

Absolutely delicious! Loved the wide selection of vegan options. The vegan ramen and sushi were really good. The atmosphere really elevated our dinner experience. Can’t wait to come back!
Quite expensive for what it is
Ramen is truly delicious
Vegan pumpkin katsu curry is my favourite! Ramen is nice too but the vegan bacon is too reminiscent of real flesh, just wish you guys used a different brand.

Because of the price i thought the food will be amazing, honestly it was pretty mid, the noodles where store bought and the broth in the ramen didn't have much flavour. Also when we were paying they instantly charged us 10% tip we didn't even knew that we were paying it, wouldn't recommend.

Awesome food and great service just near busy Edinburgh Castle. Well you will have to walk little bit but its a nice walk.
Ordered few items which were halal. They do halal items but not all of them are. Taste was very good. Highly recommended
Great dinner in the centre of Edinburgh! Attentive and speedy service, lota of vegan options- would fully recommend for lunch or a quick dinner
This was one of the best halal ramen meals I've had in Edinburgh. The seafood broth was rich and flavorful, and the noodles were perfectly cooked.
Food was served quickly. Great atmosphere and very good ramen!

Fantastic!

I don't recall seeing large groups because the tables aren't big and it's geared towards individual tables; I'd recommend a maximum of...

Quick, tasty, cheap for the quality. No reservations needed.

My partner and I were in need of some comfort food after a long day's travel and Maki & Ramen's was just the thing! The atmosphere was lovely, the staff were very quick and attentive plus the food was great! I had the salmon sushi platter which was brill and my partner loved his Steak Ramen! Presentation was great...

Absolutely lovely service and atmosphere. The food and the lemonade were delicious. We are definitely going back next time we visit Edinburgh.

Loved it! Highly recommend.

Been in here a few times, staff always pleasant and friendly.

amazing food and very cozy

Hannah the waitress was super helpful and gave us a lot of time day with true honest recommendations. Tasty ramen would recommend.
Nice bowl of hot ramen. No complaints. Staff are nice. Service is quick. Price is reasonable for what you get.
Really nice atmosphere and amazing food and service! You may need to wait for a table; but we only waited like 15 minutes. Excellent service and food was quick and very tasty.

Recommend!!! Love that they have halal options, and staff is super nice :)
